name: Jet Amplifier - Ballistics
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Ballistics capability.

61212.name: Flying Device I · Ballistics
61212.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
